title: Section-normalized tensor comparison for module restriction
statement: Let (C,J) and (D,K) be sites essentially small in the coefficient universe w [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], f:C→D a continuous and cocontinuous functor, and R,S sheaves of commutative rings. Let a be an isomorphism from the underlying ring sheaf of R to f_* of the underlying ring sheaf of S. For the module restriction U=SheafOfModules.pushforward(a.hom) [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], there is a family e(M,N):U(M tensor N)≅UM tensor UN, natural in both module sheaves for the ordinary sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. For each V in C and sections x,y of M,N over f(V), e(M,N) takes their pure section [def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-pure-section] to the pure section of UM,UN defined by the same x,y. No site equivalence, nonzero-ring or point hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Equip presheaf restriction with its existing lax tensorator. Its components are scalar-restriction tensor maps. The proved restrictScalars_mu_isIso helper makes them invertible because the scalar map a is an isomorphism. Reflect componentwise invertibility to obtain an isomorphism of presheaf tensors; no full monoidal structure on restriction is needed.

Compose the inverse presheaf tensorator, its sheafification, the restriction-sheafification isomorphism, and the ordinary tensor/sheafification isomorphisms. The restrictionSheafificationMap_unit_apply equation and naturality of the sheafification unit compute the inverse on each pure tensor. Cancellation gives the forward pure-section formula.

Precompose the naturality equation with the inverse comparison and cancel its composite with the forward comparison on the right. The pure_hom_ext lemma reduces equality to pure sections. The inverse formula, pure_map and the forward formula then give the same pair of mapped sections on both sides.

lean.statement:
theorem sectionwiseTensorComparison
    (f : C ⥤ D) [f.IsContinuous J K] [f.IsCocontinuous J K]
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{w}) (S : Sheaf K CommRingCat.{w})
    (a : (sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R ≅
      (f.sheafPushforwardContinuous RingCat.{w} J K).obj
        ((sheafCompose K (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj S)) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.isMonoidal_W_independentCoefficients S
    letI := SheafOfModules.isMonoidal_W_independentCoefficients R
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory S
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R
    let U := SheafOfModules.pushforward.{w} a.hom
    ∃ e : ∀ M N : scalarModules K S, U.obj (M ⊗ N) ≅ U.obj M ⊗ U.obj N,
      (∀ {M M' N N'} (f : M ⟶ M') (h : N ⟶ N'),
        U.map (f ⊗ₘ h) ≫ (e M' N').hom =
          (e M N).hom ≫ (U.map f ⊗ₘ U.map h)) ∧
      ∀ (M N : scalarModules K S) (V : Cᵒᵖ)
        (x : M.val.obj (f.op.obj V))
        (y : N.val.obj (f.op.obj V)),
        (e M N).hom.val.app V
          (SheafOfModules.ScalarHomOrdinary.pure S M N
            (f.op.obj V) x y) =
        SheafOfModules.ScalarHomOrdinary.pure R (U.obj M) (U.obj N) V x y
